calendar.limitations: Union of stored validated dates; missing dates or holidays cannot be certified as exchange closures.

policies.structural: Numeric OHLCV and unique observed date; partial_ohlc allowed if structurally complete
policies.sourceProvenance: Structural plus dated per-bar source evidence and quarantine exclusion, without security identity
policies.strict: Source provenance plus ISO 6166 valid security identity and consistent ticker/currency/exchange
policies.license: Unverified rights never imply permission to redistribute; no automatic vendor download
policies.eligibility: Current streak ends on auditDate; trailingAtOwnLatest ends on each ticker last stored date; historical maximum is separate
policies.performance: No strategy calibration or OOS certification; no trade orders
